name: io.github.x007xyz/flycut-caption
title: FlyCut Caption
description: Local-first AI video subtitle editor MCP server for project creation, ASR transcription, review-only edit suggestions, and subtitle/video export with human-in-the-loop confirmation.

packageArguments.name: --host
packageArguments.description: Optional FlyCut Host URL (defaults to discovery via ~/.flycut-caption/host/connection.json)

packageArguments.name: --home
packageArguments.description: Optional FlyCut Host home directory containing connection.json

environmentVariables.name: FLYCUT_HOST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional FlyCut Host HTTP URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8766)
